If that is a crime, then why does not the law charge our great imposters who pretend to be people's 'leaders' & 'liberators' and are nothing but crooks in pay a service of big gangsters. Why does not the law protest against the blasphemy of a court magistrate demanding to be addressed as 'Lordship'. There is nothing hard-like in a Christian hypocrite, who pretends to be just and yet with every action in court breaks the law of his God, who forbids him to judge others. The court reporters who glorify our existing 'rotten order', the hypocrisy & brutality of our 'justice' and shamelessly make the unfortunate & poor in their tasteless press reports, the prison doctor who under the mask of a man of science the probation officer who under the disguise of 'a servant of humanity', degrade themselves to police informers, the judge who in many interest of his masters turns an conscienceless executor of the Little Sinners and closes his eyes towards the crimes of the Great—these people are abusing the names of every day & hour, crime, that uphold the present system, cause the slaughter of suffering of millions. And they want me to recognize them & their laws as justice.

Then arrested, the police took everything I had on me away and declared it unlawful possession. After I refused all information, swearing myself the offered to give me my money back if I would sign for it. Having no money & him not able to write letters, buy newspapers or cigarettes, they thought that I, being deprived of these 'privileges' would give up my silly attitude.
